title: Max XOR Pair
statement_md: Two fighters combine their power codes with XOR. Choose two **different positions** to make the combined power as large as possible.
input_md: The first line holds $n$. The second line holds $n$ integers.
output_md: Print the maximum of $a_i \oplus a_j$ over $i \ne j$.
hints: Pattern: build the answer greedily from the highest bit.
Keep the best prefix found so far. For the next bit, try prefix | bit: it is achievable if two prefixes in the set XOR to it.

reference_solution:
import sys


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    a = list(map(int, data[1:1 + n]))
    ans = 0
    mask = 0
    for b in range(29, -1, -1):
        mask |= 1 << b
        pre = {v & mask for v in a}
        cand = ans | (1 << b)
        for p in pre:
            if cand ^ p in pre:
                ans = cand
                break
    print(ans)


main()
